svg.title: Fusion loop · evidence to alarm state
svg.desc: Buffered visual evidence and asynchronous sensor features are aligned and validated, mapped to basic probability assignments, fused using Dempster-Shafer theory, transformed into risk and passed through smoothing and a hysteresis state machine.
svg.text: Fusion loop · evidence to alarm state
Thermal ~8–16 Hz; CO / PM update more slowly.
Fusion reads buffered values without waiting for every camera frame.
BPA: basic probability assignment · BetP: pignistic probability · FSM thresholds use seconds, not frame counts
